director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket pitch jaisi number line par fractions rakhenge. Tumhe cricket mein batting ya bowling pasand hai?
samajh nahi aaya

Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai. Pitch ko 0 se 1 tak ek seedhi line socho.
haan samajh gayi
Screen par 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur theek beech mein ek mark. Yeh mark 0 se 1 ko 2 barabar gaps mein baant raha hai, aur is mark ka naam 1/2 hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
samajh nahi aaya

0 se 1 ki line ko 2 barabar gaps mein baanto. Beech wala mark 1/2 hai, aur woh 0 aur 1 ke beech hi hai. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

Cricket yaad rahega; yeh sawaal khatam karke uspar aate hain.

Achha, tumne apna tareeka bataya. Mujhe bhi cricket pasand hai, khaaskar jab batsman zor se ball maarta hai. Screen par wahi 0 se 1 ki rekha hai, aur rekha ke upar ab beech mein 3 marks hain. Marks nahi, gaps dekho: 4 barabar gaps hain, isliye 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/4 hai. Isi rekha ke neeche ki taraf beech mein 7 marks hain. Yahan tak theek hai?
mujhe nahi pata
Marks mat gino, gaps gino. Rekha ke upar 3 marks se 4 barabar gaps bante hain. Ab is par ek chhota sawaal.
hmm, achha
Isi rekha ke neeche ki taraf 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 nishaan barabar doori par hain. Neeche ki taraf rekha kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

Screen par 0 se 1 metre tak ka ribbon hai, beech mein 3 chalk ke nishaan hain, aur ribbon 4 barabar hisson mein bata hai. Pehla nishaan wahan hai jahan pehla barabar hissa khatam hota hai, isliye woh 1/4 metre par hai. Isi rekha ke neeche ki taraf 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 nishaan barabar doori par hain. Neeche ki taraf rekha kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

director.text: Bilkul, 7 nishaan 8 barabar gaps banate hain, kyunki beech ke nishaan se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain, 7 + 1 = 8. Screen par 0 se 1 ki rekha ab 8 barabar gaps mein bati hai, toh har gap pehle se chhota gap hai. Pehla nishaan 1/8 hai, bilkul 0 ke paas, aur beech wala nishaan abhi bhi 1/2 hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
haan
Theek hai, Riya. Agar yahi rekha 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1 by 10
Sahi, Riya, kyunki 10 barabar gaps ka har gap 5 gaps wale gap se chhota hai, toh 1/10, 0 ke zyada paas rukta hai.
haan, woh maine bata diya

Theek hai, Riya. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 km par. Ghar aur school ke beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par lage hain. Pehla khamba ghar se kitne km door hai? Diya hai: ghar 0 par, school 1 km par, beech mein 3 khambe, barabar doori par. Dhoondhna hai: pehle khambe ki ghar se doori, km mein. Ab agla kadam dekhte hain.
haan
Pehla kadam dekho. Rekha banao aur ghar ko 0 par, school ko 1 par likho: 0 se 1 tak ki rekha, kyunki 0 se 1 tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
samajh nahi aaya
Ghar ko 0 par aur school ko 1 par rakho. Ghar se school tak ka poora raasta ek poora hai. Ab isse aage chalte hain.
theek hai
Ab doosra kadam. Khambe nahi, beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe, toh 4 barabar hisse, kyunki beech ke nishaan se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain. Ab agla kadam dekhte hain.
theek hai
Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?
